description: Frapea's SAMPLE MEDIA, for trying the editor without your own footage: a short talking clip with speech and pauses (for transcripts, captions, removing words or silences), a b-roll shot, a photo and a music bed. No API key, no download from elsewhere. Call with no `ids` to list them; call with `ids` (or `all: true`) to copy them into the project's media pool at the Library root — each result gives a mediaRef for add_clips. Adding one already in the project returns its existing mediaRef.

ids.description: Sample ids to add (talk, broll, photo, music). Omit to list them.

token.description: The session token `connect` returned. Pass it on every call — it says which browser to drive.

name: add_sample_media
title: Add sample media
